minor.issue: Dead code block at server.py L3147-3281 lives INSIDE the stock_adjust function body, after the `return` on L3145. Looks like an orphaned/duplicated seed block that was mistakenly nested inside the endpoint when Fix pack 2 was inserted. It is unreachable so does not affect behaviour, but it is misleading (grep for `insert_one.*business` lights up inside stock_adjust) and should be deleted. Live seed functions are at L2276 (seed_demo) and L2827 (seed_if_empty).

action_items: Remove the dead orphaned seed block inside stock_adjust (server.py L3147-end-of-indented-block) — it is unreachable code after `return` on L3145.

server.py is now 3298 lines; strongly recommend splitting into routers (roles, approvals, attendance, cash, stock) before adding more endpoints. The previous orphaned-decorator bug and this orphaned-seed-block are both symptoms of inserting new sections into one giant file.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code inside POST /stock/adjustments (L3147+) — orphaned seed logic nested in the wrong function.
GET /audit-logs uses `{"$regex": action}` with raw user input — tiny ReDoS risk, consider anchoring/escaping or restricting to a whitelist.

declare_handover accepts amount from any authenticated user via Depends(get_user) — may want to restrict to manager/caissiere role (currently admin can also call it, livreur too). Not a security issue because handover_by is logged, but worth tightening.
manager_balance route uses require_role("admin","manager") — but any manager can read anyone's balance by passing another mid. Consider enforcing mid == current user for non-admins.

/attendance/check-in rider departure flag uses `user.get("role") == "rider"`. If a seeded rider has role 'livreur' the flag will not fire — confirm the seed is consistent (test skipped-safely-handles this; in the preview env the seeded role is `rider`, flag fired correctly).
attendance_stats avg_arrival computes an int average of minutes without filtering timezone — adequate for display but assumes UTC-stored times.

rca of the issue: No bug blocking Fix pack 2. Single hygiene finding: inserting the Fix pack 2 block before the pre-existing demo-seed block left the seed block nested inside the last defined endpoint (stock_adjust), after a `return`. Reproduction: `grep -n '^    # Business' server.py` returns a line inside stock_adjust's body. Mitigation: cut L3147 through the end of the orphaned block and either delete (if seed_if_empty at L2827 is authoritative) or move to the correct seed function.
